TestCaseName: Successful booking with an available time slot
Steps: 1. Log in; 2. Select doctor; 3. Select an available slot; 4. Confirm booking

TestCaseName: Booking fails when the time slot is already taken
Steps: 1. Log in; 2. Select doctor; 3. Select an already-booked slot; 4. Confirm
ExpectedResult: System rejects with message 'slot already booked'

TestCaseName: Cancel appointment succeeds more than 2 hours before
Steps: 1. Open appointment; 2. Cancel with >2h remaining before slot

TestCaseName: Cancel appointment rejected within 2 hours before
Steps: 1. Open appointment; 2. Cancel with <2h remaining before slot
ExpectedResult: System rejects, shows cancellation policy message

TestCaseName: Warning shown when prescription conflicts with allergy history
Steps: 1. Doctor opens prescription; 2. Add a drug conflicting with patient's allergy list
ExpectedResult: System shows a red warning and requires extra confirmation

Steps: 1. Simulate 500 concurrent users calling the doctor-search API

TestCaseName: Detect double-booking conflict for the same doctor
Steps: 1. Create 2 near-simultaneous booking requests for the same doctor and slot
ExpectedResult: System automatically rejects the 2nd request and warns within <= 1 second

TestCaseName: Registration fails with an already-used email
Steps: 1. Enter an email already registered; 2. Submit registration form
ExpectedResult: System shows error 'email already in use'

TestCaseName: Medical record data is encrypted at rest
Steps: 1. Query the 'visit_result' column directly in the database
ExpectedResult: Stored value is ciphertext, not readable as plaintext

TestCaseName: Search doctors by specialty and location returns matching results
Steps: 1. Log in as patient; 2. Open doctor search; 3. Enter specialty=Cardiology and location=District 1; 4. Submit search
ExpectedResult: System displays only doctors whose specialty and location match the filters

TestCaseName: Doctor updates a patient's medical record after a visit
Steps: 1. Log in as doctor; 2. Open the patient's visit history; 3. Add a new visit result and save
ExpectedResult: Visit history is displayed and the new result is stored in the medical record
